caption: The drawing depicts a single candlestick placed centrally on a plain, off-white background with a rectangular border. The candlestick has a slightly hourglass-shaped, transparent body with subtle gray shading and highlights that suggest a glass material. The top holder part of the candlestick is colored a deep red, cylindrical in shape, and flares outwards at the rim. The base is wide, rounded, and shaded in dark green tones, giving it a solid, weighted appearance. The drawing uses clean lines and minimal detailing to indicate volume and form. The name "JOHN DANA" is written in small letters at the bottom right corner within the border.
title: Candlestick
